prose: In the 2001 election to the 140-seat Kerala Legislative Assembly, the United Democratic Front (UDF) emerged largest with 99 seats, against 40 for the LDF (1 to others/independents). Turnout was 72.46% of 21,726,837 electors.
By vote share, the UDF polled 50.58% and the LDF 42.18%, with the NDA on 5.02%. A total of 676 candidates contested the 140 seats.
Compared with 1996, the UDF gained 40 seats (from 59 to 99); the LDF moved from 80 to 40. Power changed hands from the LDF.
The closest contest was Eravipuram, won by A. A. AZEEZ (RSP) over T. A. AHAMED KABEER (IUML) by just 20 votes. The largest margin was M. K. MUNEER in Malappuram (36,017 votes).
A. K. Antony headed the Council of Ministers that followed.
